en-US.longDescription: Able2Extract Professional – a fully featured PDF suite that is designed for Windows, macOS and Linux! Using Able2Extract Professional, you can easily create secure PDFs, convert your PDF data, including scanned PDF files, into fully formatted Excel spreadsheets, editable Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, AutoCAD, CSV and more, as well as seamlessly edit and sign PDF content and pages.
en-US.name: Able2Extract Professional

zh-CN.longDescription: Able2Extract Professional —— 一款专为 Windows、macOS 及 Linux 系统打造的全功能 PDF 工具套件！通过该软件，您可轻松创建安全加密的 PDF 文档，将 PDF 数据（含扫描版 PDF 文件）精准转换为格式完整的 Excel 电子表格、可编辑的 Word 文档、PowerPoint 演示文稿、AutoCAD 文件、CSV 等格式，同时实现 PDF 内容及页面的无缝编辑与电子签名功能。
